# DEC-01: One calendar for tool renewals

## Context
Renewals of your own tools have slipped, and the reminders sit in different places (you, 2026-10-16).

## Options
- One shared calendar for every renewal, reviewed each quarter: one place to look.
- Keep the reminders where they are: nothing to set up, but they keep slipping.

## Decision
Renewals of your own tools go in one shared calendar, reviewed each quarter.
